mapper.select: SELECT id, uid, email, nickname, password, gender, birthday, join_date, account_permission, account_status, is_deleted, create_time, update_time, update_by FROM t_admin_user WHERE nickname = #{nickname}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_admin_user SET is_deleted = 0, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, uid, email, nickname, password, gender, birthday, join_date, account_permission, account_status, is_deleted, create_time, update_time, update_by FROM t_admin_user WHERE email = #{email}
SELECT id, uid, email, nickname, password, gender, birthday, join_date, account_permission, account_status, is_deleted, create_time, update_time, update_by FROM t_admin_user WHERE uid = #{uid}

SELECT uid FROM t_admin_user WHERE ( -- 情况1：已逻辑删除且超过3个月 (is_deleted = 1 AND update_time < #{logicThreshold}) OR -- 情况2：强制销号且超过120天 (account_status = 3 AND update_time < #{forceThreshold}) ) ORDER BY update_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}
